name: Wide reader on big screens
objective: On PC-width screens the reader uses more of the width: from a 1600px window, documents and book chapters get a wider column (36rem to 44rem) and every text size one step larger (x10/9, default 18px to 20px), with code, tables and figures staying in the column; below 1600px, print and the other reader pages stay as they are (re-targeted after OQ1).

review.note: Finding 1: from 1600px the 44rem column equals the wide-table min-width 44rem, so an 8+ column table that fits gets a 2px scroller, hint and fade; latent: a fitting wide table is still announced as scrolling. Fix P-8jbf.F1 (high).
